rule: Fill-path only. Stamp name= stays catalog official_field_key (TIN/branch). Unstamped leftover writer keys may be copied onto the existing cell-id name= when the freeze sheet has exactly one fillable under a printed caption that matches one leftover-unique fields.json key, and the identity catalog names that cell as html_id_hint. That is not an official_field_key harvest. Text joins ASCII-uppercase letters into comb slots and data-writer-value for BIR CAPITAL LETTERS print; digits and punctuation are unchanged. Do not mutate profile/DB values. R3 peso+cent tax rows may be listed in money_joins: one leftover money key maps to peso_html_id plus cent_html_id. Split the writer {:.2} string: pesos right-aligned in the peso comb (leading slots empty, not zero-padded, no decimal glyph), cents in the 2-slot comb. Do not stamp name= on either comb. Do not left-align the dotted string into the peso comb. Leftover boolean/radio keys may be listed in xbox_joins: when the writer is true, put X in the catalog xbox (1-char text, not type=checkbox). Do not write the string true into the box. Do not join collapsed writer txt25-28, or leftover keys that share an item number with another leftover except as documented here (year-ended MM/YYYY pair; quarter radio group).

joins.reason: exactly one 40-slot comb immediately under the item 8 caption; leftover-unique registeredName; catalog html_id_hint
exactly one full-width 40-slot comb immediately under the item 9 caption; leftover-unique registeredAddress; catalog html_id_hint
exactly one 3-slot comb on the TIN row under the item 7 caption. fields.json lists the HTA select on page 2; the freeze sheet's printed RDO box is this page-1 cell.
exactly one 4-slot comb under the ZIP Code caption. item_number 9 is shared with registeredAddress, so this join is the caption+cell, not leftover uniqueness of item 9.
exactly one 12-slot comb on the item 10 row; leftover-unique telNo; catalog html_id_hint

page-1 only. fields.json leftover_duplicate (txtEmail occurrence-1 item 11, occurrence-2 page 2). Freeze sheet has exactly one printed email comb, the 28-slot p1c39 beside tel p1c38. Catalog html_id_hint with no official_field_key. Page 2 header is TIN/name, not a second email box. Occurrence-2 stays unfilled.

item 2 Year Ended is MM + YYYY, not one cell. leftover select-one rtnMonth is the 2-slot comb immediately left of the year comb. Catalog html_id_hint with no official_field_key. Do not dump synthetic __year_ended MMYYYY into either comb.

exactly one 4-slot year comb under Year Ended, immediately right of the MM comb. leftover-unique integer txtYear (maxlength 4); catalog html_id_hint with no official_field_key. Shares fields.json item_number 2 with rtnMonth; the join is the caption+cell pair, not leftover uniqueness of item 2.

money_joins.reason: Stage 3 R3 N:1 fill-path for the page-1 tax-due amount users notice. leftover-unique decimal-money item 14. 12-slot peso comb plus 2-slot cents. Catalog official_field_key is empty on both boxes. Split insert_money {:.2}; do not stamp name=.

Stage 3 R3 N:1 fill-path for schedule 1 row 1 taxable amount (the ~54770 demo figure). Unprefixed XML key txtATCAmt1. Page-2 12-slot peso plus 2-slot cents. Catalog official_field_key is empty. Other schedule amount columns (rate, tax due, rows 2-6) stay unjoined.

xbox_joins.reason: item 1 Calendar xbox at x=85 on the header row above Year Ended. leftover boolean forThe_1. Catalog xbox, not type=checkbox. Fill X when writer is true.
item 1 Fiscal xbox at x=157. leftover boolean forThe_2. Pair with forThe_1; leave blank when false.
item 3 quarter radios share item_number; each maps to one xbox in left-to-right printed order after Year Ended (x=244). Not a stamp. Fill X when writer is true.
second quarter xbox at x=286 on the Year Ended / Quarter row. leftover qtr_2. Fill X when writer is true so a Q2 draft shows the Q2 mark.
third quarter xbox at x=329. leftover qtr_3.
fourth quarter xbox at x=371. leftover qtr_4.

not_joined.reason: Synthetic MMYYYY helper on the writer map, not a fields.json key and not a freeze cell. Year Ended is the rtnMonth + txtYear pair (p1c9/p1c10). Do not dump 122026 into one comb.
Item 4 Yes/No xboxes (p1c16/p1c17) sit on the same header row but are not the year-ended / quarter demo fill. Same xbox contract as qtr_*; left unjoined this slice.
2-slot comb p1c14 on the far right of the header row (number of sheets). Not year-ended.
Remaining Part I radios (tax relief, item 13 taxRate, overpayment) stay on cell-id name= without an xbox join.
HTA/DOM duplicate of the same serialized key. Page 2 freeze header is TIN/name (p2c5/p2c6), not a second email comb. Page-1 p1c39 is the printed email box.
Same R3 N:1 peso+cent pair as the other Part II amount rows. Only txt14 (page 1) and txtATCAmt1 (schedule taxable) are demo-joined.
Schedule 1 tax-due column is a separate peso+cent pair. Demo fill uses txtATCAmt1 plus page-1 txt14; this column stays unjoined.
Writer emits collapsed txt25-28 blanks; fields.json inventories payment columns as txtAgency/txtAmount/txtDate/txtNumber. name-gaps already pins this absence.
